description: Meatrol (Shanghai Pinyan) ME440 hand-held three-phase power meter over Modbus TCP: voltages, currents, power, energy, demand, harmonics, minimum and maximum, unbalance and settings
source: Shanghai Pinyan M&C Technology (Meatrol), ME440 three-phase hand-held meter user manual V4.0, Modbus register list

sources.title: ME440 三相手持式电表 说明书 (ME440 three-phase hand-held meter user manual)
sources.note: Modbus communication summary and Modbus register list (pages 19-42); the file is served with the PDF title "ME631 Three-phase Power Meter"

notes: Modbus TCP over Ethernet (RJ45), port 502; the manual gives 192.168.1.5 as the default IP address. Functions 03 (read holding registers) and 16 (write multiple registers) only. The manual is a Chinese-language document.

The manual describes the ME440. The earlier unofficial MP440 table from the Modbus Database has the same addresses as the ME440 register list (current at 1000, voltage input type at 99, VT secondary at 102), so MP440 is taken to be the same instrument; this is an assumption.

Register addresses are the decimal numbers of the manual and are used as printed (IA is 1000), address base 0. Float32 values are IEEE 754 single precision, two registers each. The manual does not state the byte or word order; big-endian with the high word first is assumed.

Registers marked R/WC in the manual (wiring, CT and VT settings, clock, SD card) are read here as read-only: they are changed only by writing a command code and its parameters to registers 300 to 423 with function 16 and reading the result at 424 and 425. Commands: 1000 set time, 1001 wiring and frequency, and further commands for the CT and VT settings, listed in the manual.

The manual lists energy twice: 32-bit unsigned in kWh, kvarh and kVAh (2000 to 2047) and 64-bit unsigned in Wh, varh and VAh (2500 to 2595). The manual types the phase B active export 64-bit entry (2520) as UInt32 with size 4; it is taken as 64-bit like its neighbours.

Date and time values (clock, peak-demand times) are four registers; the manual gives the fields (year since 2000, month and day, hour and minute, milliseconds) and they are listed as one 64-bit value to be decoded by bit fields. The harmonic ranges the manual abbreviates (harmonics 3 to 50) are expanded here: phases A, B, C in turn for each order.
Registers 110 and 111 (SD card) have no data type in the manual; unsigned 16-bit is assumed.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Date and time
registers.description: Four registers: 73 year since 2000 (0-99); 74 month (high byte) and day (low byte); 75 hour (high byte) and minute (low byte); 76 milliseconds (0-59999). Changed with configuration command 1000, not by direct write
